name: gizza-ai/extract-pdf-images
summary: Extract embedded images from a PDF as a ZIP.

tool.description: Extract the embedded raster images from a PDF and return them bundled in a ZIP. JPEG (DCTDecode) and JPEG-2000 images are saved losslessly as-is; 8-bit grayscale/RGB images are saved as PNG. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). This extracts stored image objects — it does not rasterize/screenshot pages.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
